name: range-shooter
description: Realistic FPS prototype: shooting range, one rifle, dummies. TypeScript + Babylon.js + Electron.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron . --dev"
